name: CIBRS Group B Public Crime Data
description: Sample of detailed CIBRS Group B data, received from ARJIS. Filtered for the public.

Additional Information.Methodology: Crimes reported by various police departments in the San Deigo region

columns.name: Incident UID
columns.description: Numeric ID for each NIBRS crime incident

columns.name: Arrest Agency
columns.description: Reporting Agency on crime case or arrest

columns.name: CIBRS Unique Offense ID
columns.description: Unique Group B Offense ID *please note that each incident may have multiple arrests

columns.name: Crime Against Category
columns.description: If the crime is a crime against Persons, Property or Society

columns.name: Arrest Number
columns.description: Unique ID for each arrest, these may repeat across agency

columns.name: Cibrs Status
columns.description: The status of the incident in the CIBRS CA DOJ Portal, whether it has been accepted and ingested into the state data repository

columns.name: Cibrs Status Date
columns.description: The date the incident was ingested into the state data portal

columns.name: Domestic Violence Incident
columns.description: If any occurrence of domestic violence was flagged by the reporting officer on the crime case

columns.name: BCS Area
columns.description: Sheriff BCS Reporting Area where crime occurred (this will only be present on sheriff cases)
